[[File:Racing_Skiff_Dark.jpg|thumb|250px|Racing skiff piloted by Vedain]]
A '''racing skiff''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] that was modified for racing.<ref name="Racing Dark">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck|cardname=Racing Skiff (Dark)}}</ref> Young thrill-seekers on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] stripped down the skiffs and upgraded their engines.<ref name="Racing Light">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck|cardname=Racing Skiff (Light)}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] repulsorlift vehicle mechanic [[Barada/Legends|Barada]] and his assistant [[Klaatu/Legends|Klaatu]] were known to build racing skiffs to race on the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Racing Dark" /> Pilots that participated in the races included [[Vedain/Legends|Vedain]]<ref name="Racing Dark" /> and [[Brock Starsher/Legends|Brock Starsher]].<ref name="Racing Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Racing skiffs first appeared on card in the ''[[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]'' set from [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'', featuring modified photos of [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiffs]] from [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].
